comment:overrides: @gltf-transform/cli pins sharp ~0.34.5 while its ndarray-pixels dependency wants a newer one, so npm installs BOTH — and two libvips copies in one process disagree about the VipsInterpretation enum, which makes every `gltf-transform resize` die with 'colourspace: parameter space not set'. One sharp for the whole tree (issue #919).
